lounges.name: LATAM Signature Lounge
lounges.location: Level 4; pass through duty free after security, then turn left.

hours.note: Opens at 05:00 daily; closes at midnight in standard time and 01:00 during daylight saving time. Seasonal dates are not represented in this guide; confirm the closing time for your travel date.

accessRules.label: Delta One
conditions: Your boarding pass must be for Delta One on this departing international segment.

accessRules.label: Eligible Delta SkyMiles Medallion status on LATAM or Delta
accessRules.note: Show your valid SkyMiles tier and same-day international boarding pass.

sources.title: LATAM Santiago: separate lounge tiers, hours and access

recommendation.summary: A premium international lounge with dedicated quiet and sleeping areas; confirm its seasonal closing time.

lounges.note: Signature is distinct from the Premium and Santander WorldMember lounges. Premium Economy and Delta Gold alone do not qualify for Signature. LATAM Pass Black/Black Signature benefits are not yet represented in settings.

qualityRating.summary: The September 2024 visit praises the design, varied food and drinks, and sleeping and shower facilities. A standout airline lounge in that review, rather than simply a place to wait.

sources.title: One Mile at a Time · LATAM Signature Santiago firsthand review

lounges.name: SkyTeam Lounge
lounges.location: After security and passport control, Pier E, first floor; use the lift on Level 3.

accessRules.label: Priority Pass on a SkyTeam operated flight
Priority Pass on a SkyTeam codeshare

sources.title: Priority Pass: SkyTeam Santiago and airline restriction

recommendation.summary: A 24-hour lounge with showers and a quiet area; Priority Pass access requires a SkyTeam-operated or SkyTeam-marketed flight.

lounges.note: Priority Pass access is limited to SkyTeam flights or SkyTeam codeshares; membership by itself does not qualify on an unrelated flight. Airline-invitation access is not yet modeled.

qualityRating.summary: The September 2024 review found comfortable seating and a decent drinks selection, but underwhelming food. A functional place to wait rather than a reason to arrive early.

sources.title: One Mile at a Time · SkyTeam Santiago firsthand review
